disclaimer.strong: This page compares pregnancy and cycle apps.
disclaimer.rest: It is educational, not medical advice, and no clinician has reviewed it yet.

doctor: Call your hospital or doctor if you have heavy bleeding, severe pain, trouble breathing, a severe headache, blurred vision, a high fever, or reduced baby movement after movements have started.
title: Wholesome Girlies vs Flo vs Clue: Cycle Tracker Guide
description: Compare Wholesome Girlies, Flo and Clue for cycle tracking, fertile days, symptoms, privacy and prices in Nigeria, the UK and the United States.
share: Compare Wholesome Girlies, Flo and Clue by symptoms, fertile days, privacy, sign-up and price.
h1: Wholesome Girlies vs Flo vs Clue
crumb: Wholesome Girlies vs Flo vs Clue
kicker: For women choosing a period tracker while trying to conceive
answer: Choose Flo if you want daily symptom entries, reminders and a large health library. Choose Clue if you want detailed cycle guides and more than 200 symptoms and experiences to track. Choose Wholesome Girlies if you want a simple fertile day calculator, dates kept on your phone, clinic questions and a plan written for Nigerian women.

rows.label: Do I have to sign up?
Where are my health dates kept?
cells: On Flo servers. Flo says it does not sell health data.
On European servers. Clue says sensitive health data is never sold to advertisers.

rows.label: Can I note symptoms?
cells: No. It saves period start dates.
Yes. More than 200 symptoms and experiences.

rows.label: What does it cost?
cells: The tools need no payment. The Blueprint is paid once.
Android users in Nigeria get Premium for one year with no payment. iPhone users pay ₦3,900 (about $3) to ₦29,900 (about $22).
Nigerian users pay ₦1,500 (about $1) to ₦12,900 (about $10). UK users pay £7.99 monthly or up to £24.99 yearly. US users pay $9.99 monthly or $39.99 yearly.

rows.label: Can I prepare for my clinic visit?
cells: Print fertility questions and send your husband a sperm health checklist.
Read the health library and use its symptom checker.
Read expert cycle guides and use Clue Conceive for fertile day estimates.

wins.h: Your dates stay on your phone
wins.b: The period dates you enter are saved on your phone. A forget button clears them.

wins.h: Clinic questions for both of you
wins.b: Print your questions for the fertility doctor. Send your husband a checklist for his sperm health and sperm test questions.

other_ahead_title: Where Flo and Clue are ahead

other_ahead.b: Flo lets you note more than 70 symptoms, sends reminders and has a large health library.
Clue lets you note more than 200 symptoms and experiences. Its Conceive mode estimates fertile days.

picks.b: if you want daily symptoms, reminders and a large health library.
if you want detailed cycle guides and more factors to track.
if you want a simple calculator, phone-only dates and clinic questions.

faq.q: Does Clue sell health data to advertisers?
faq.a: Clue's privacy policy says the sensitive health data you track is never shared with or sold to advertisers. It says limited technical and usage data may be shared for advertising when permission is on.

The listed price depends on the store. Nigeria shows ₦1,500 (about $1) to ₦12,900 (about $10). The United Kingdom shows £7.99 monthly and up to £24.99 yearly. The United States shows $9.99 monthly and $39.99 yearly.
